commit.message:
8388924: RISC-V: Add Zbb xnor instruction selection rules

The Zbb extension defines xnor rd, rs1, rs2 = ~(rs1 ^ rs2), but riscv_b.ad
had no rule to select it, so the compiler always expanded ~(a ^ b) into an
xor plus a not.

Add xnorI_reg_reg_b and xnorL_reg_reg_b, which match the XorI(XorI(a, b),
-1) tree shape, so that ~(a ^ b) is selected as a single xnor instruction
when UseZbb is enabled.

Testing:
- compiler.c2.riscv64.TestXnor: verifies FINAL_CODE selects xnorI_reg_reg_b
  and xnorL_reg_reg_b for ~(a ^ b), a ^ ~b and ~a ^ b (int and long)
- hotspot jtreg compiler/codegen: all pass
- hotspot jtreg compiler/integerArithmetic: all pass

Signed-off-by: Xiaofei Gong <gongxiaofei24@iscas.ac.cn>
Signed-off-by: YuanSheng <yuansheng@isrc.iscas.ac.cn>
